extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology from main-text methods/results/discussion and figure captions; claims are bounded to phenotype/mechanism evidence available locally.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AfpB has fungicidal activity against P. digitatum conidia under the reported MIC and 4x MIC exposure assay, with PAF26 used as a positive control.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The final record does not recover exact figure-only percentage values beyond the qualitative source statement and figure locator.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: dAfpB9 retains fungistatic/MIC activity similar to AfpB for most fungi but lacks detectable fungicidal activity against P. digitatum conidia in the same assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This supports a phenotype-level fungicidal/fungistatic distinction, not a molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper maps fungicidal determinants to AfpB loop L3 where the dAfpB9 modifications are located, but this is an inference from designed mutations and phenotype rather than a resolved molecular target.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: AfpB loop L3 and dAfpB9 modifications
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote this to a direct molecular target or pathway claim.
